text_block_list.text:
A short time had passed since Symboli
Kris S 
had come to Tracen Academy. One day―

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
……Huu…… huuu…… Hu 
――――Haaaaa……!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
It's just practice,
but such intensity……! It's not just her 
acceleration,
she's definitely got wonderful potential!

Symboli Kris S' running excited the crowd
that 
had naturally gathered.
She definitely has incredible 
intensity and abilities. But――

I couldn't help but be fascinated by her sharp,
straight-forward 
gaze.
I had an idea of what that gaze was focused
on.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
And my mission――I will complete it without
fail.
A gust of wind blows past.

She passed by the stands in the blink of an
eye, her back 
receding in to the distance.
What 『Mission』 was it that she 
sought to fulfill?――

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Kris S-san! I can see your potential,
it was 
a splendid run.
Especially your strength on the 
straights! By all means, contract with――

text_block_list.name: Experienced Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, talking to her first is no fair,
senpai! Kris S-san, 
would you mind listening to what I have to
say……?

……Maybe it was because she was staying silent,
but the group of 
people around her seemed to grow larger and
larger.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
How does this sound?
We decide on an order, 
and each of us acts as Kris S' trainer
temporarily for a day?

text_block_list.name: Experienced Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
I see. After she's worked with each of us,
she 
can select the one she has the best
compatability 
with……does that work for you, Kris S-san?

Suddenly,
my eyes met with Symboli Kris S'. 
In those eyes,
I could see she seemed troubled――

Without thinking,
I stepped in front of my senpai. 
Shouldn't we listen to Symboli Kris S
first?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: No problem. ――I don't mind.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
……She's the one saying it,
so I guess that's settled. 
So then, let's iron out a schedule first――

In the end,
this ended up becoming a way to decide
Symboli 
Kris S' trainer,
essentially a 『Trainer Selection』 event.
choice_data_list: (I should learn as much as I can……!)

text_block_list.text:
There was Symboli Rudolf's request to 『Look
after her』, 
and I could also learn from my senpai!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Judging by the data from yesterday's run,
it seems like your 
aptitude is for medium distances on turf.
In short, I think you 
can go for the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
That's why,
2400m on turf―― let's try keeping the Derby
in mind while you run. Along with that,
try thinking about things like 
your approach and pace management!

Symboli Kris S calmly carried out the 
training menu……or so it seemed. However――

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Huh……? On the final straight, 
I thought she'd push even harder……

The next day too, while training 
with the second trainer candidate――

text_block_list.name: Experienced Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
With your physique and the power you
showed 
in your run! Until your debut,
I think focusing 
on strength training would be suitable.

text_block_list.name: Experienced Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
So how about starting with slope
training? 
With you,
it should make a huge difference for your
debut!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ……Sorry, I cant―― do that yet.

text_block_list.name: Experienced Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Eh, do you dislike slopes? Hmmmm, 
I thought it would go well though……

And so, the next day,
and the day after that―― Symboli Kris S 
didn't seem to be so on board with this
arrangement.

text_block_list.name: Experienced Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
……And that's how it goes. 
She'll change the training menu on her own,
you know?

text_block_list.name: Experienced Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
When I ask her why,
the only thing I get back 
is 『For my mission』…… it seems like she's
quite 
the temperamental type, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Same here…… I thought her acceleration power
was wonderful but, 
she just can't seem to pull away.
I'm not sure what to do……

I wonder if Symboli Kris S was okay―― I
thought about it, 
and decided I should talk to her and find
out.

It seemed like she wasn't willing to compromise
at all. 
I asked her if the trainers' methods were
the problem――

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: …… ……――Problem.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
About the trainers―― themselves,
there's no…… problem. 
――They're thinking about me. ――Seriously.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
……There's something that―― I want to
prioritize. 
――――My…… mission.

text_block_list.name: Kris S' Mentor
text_block_list.text:
――An Uma Musume like you,
will revolutionize the racing 
world in Japan. One day,
I believe that will happen.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――Make the Japanese racing world,
more exciting―― to do that.

I could tell right away that she wasn't
dodging the question. 
――Her eyes, were just too straightforward.
